items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let me ask you something. I got to meet Claude “Fiddler” Williams. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Was he? I didn’t know about that.

ctx.x: No Earl Hines. There’s only one Earl. But anyway it was a great success, it was wonderful. And so I knew that I really fell in love with the Basie band, because that was THE band, and THE rhythm section, and Lester. And of course the brass.
Let me ask you something. I got to meet Claude “Fiddler” Williams. And apparently when Basie first came to New York, Claude was in the guitar chair.
Was he? I didn’t know about that.
